game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Spirit Hall, a hall of wandering spirits: the scholar mage must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of spirit candles while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Spirit Hall: a hall of wandering spirits
core_gameplay_loop: In Spirit Hall, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of spirit candles while keeping the order. Each round, a new spirit candles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 460 points of spirit candles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 460, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 10 (extended tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Spirit Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
